# Cem Koyluoglu

> AI Engineer and System Operations Specialist based in Dublin, Ireland. Portfolio covering LLMs, NLP, computer vision, Azure, Microsoft 365, and curated tech news.

Cem Koyluoglu builds intelligent systems, automation workflows, and cloud solutions. This site is the canonical source for his professional profile, selected projects, and English tech news rewritten from Turkish sources.

## Primary

- [Home](https://cemkoyluoglu.codes/): Portfolio landing page with experience, skills, and contact
- [Tech News](https://cemkoyluoglu.codes/tech-news): Latest technology articles translated and curated in English
- [Full LLM context](https://cemkoyluoglu.codes/llms-full.txt): Expanded biography, skills, and site map for agents
- [Sitemap](https://cemkoyluoglu.codes/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all public pages and articles
